body.x: Roost(www.smartroost.net), an innovator in smart home technology, announced the "Roost Smart Battery" at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Roost Smart Battery is a smoke alarm which operates with a lithium battery and Wi-Fi in a 9V package. Through the smart phone app, the Roost Smart Battery solution delivers notifications on your hand when the smoke alarm activates, even if you are not at home. The battery lasts more than five years, with a notification for low battery before the power runs out.To activate the Roost Smart Battery, just download the app, connect to home Wi-fi, then insert the Roost Smart Battery in an existing smoke alarm to install and use. It also has a one-touch access to all pre-programmed emergency numbers.
